sn47.25:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn47.25:1.3: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn47.25:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.25:1.5: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.25:1.6: ko pana bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
sn47.25:2.1: catunnaṃ kho brāhmaṇa satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.25:2.2: catunnaṃ ca kho brāhmaṇa satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.25:3.2: idha brāhmaṇa bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.25:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.25:3.6: imesaṃ kho brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hoti.
sn47.25:3.7: imesaṃ ca kho brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
sn47.25:4.1: evaṃ vutte so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.25:4.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. pe.
sn47.25:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
